cases.name: etaf-org-tests-narrow-heading-keeps-its-chips
cases.purpose: A heading keeps its keyword, priority and title at a narrow measure.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-footnotes-in-lists-share-one-sequence
cases.purpose: Footnote references inside list items share the document sequence.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-toc-skips-commented-sections
cases.purpose: A COMMENT section stays out of the table of contents and stays folded.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-file-title-drops-the-extension
cases.purpose: A document without a title names itself by its file, without the .org suffix.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-children-fold-leaves-subheadings-openable
cases.purpose: A section shown as children still lets its subheadings open.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-metadata-and-counts
cases.purpose: A document reports its title, outline, section count, status counts and degradation count through a state snapshot.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-outline-carries-keyword-priority-tags
cases.purpose: The outline exposes each headline's level, title, id, keyword and tags so navigation and tests see the same document model.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-create-requires-a-source
cases.purpose: Creating a session without a file or text signals `etaf-org-error' instead of returning a half-built session.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-create-reports-a-missing-file
cases.purpose: An unreadable document names the missing path in the preview's own error type.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-refresh-rereads-the-file
cases.purpose: Refreshing a file session republishes the file's current heading and body, replacing the stale render.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-refresh-keeps-the-document-on-failure
cases.purpose: A failed refresh keeps the last good document published and signals the preview error.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-state-is-detached
cases.purpose: Mutating a state snapshot never changes the session, so callers can inspect and cache it safely.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-fold-hides-the-body
cases.purpose: Folding a section removes its body and every descendant body from the visible buffer while keeping the headline.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-fold-children-keeps-child-headlines
cases.purpose: The children fold state shows child headlines and hides both the parent body and the child bodies.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-sections-open-by-default
cases.purpose: Every ordinary section body is rendered in the reader.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-fold-all-updates-every-section
cases.purpose: A document-wide fold writes every section's cell and reports the same state for all of them.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-fold-unknown-section-errors
cases.purpose: An unknown section or fold state signals `etaf-org-error' rather than silently doing nothing.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-fold-publishes-one-region
cases.purpose: Folding one section publishes a small buffer update, proving the document is not re-rendered as a whole.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-inline-emphasis-and-code-faces
cases.purpose: Bold, italic, underline, strike-through and verbatim spans render their own face attributes and drop their markers.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-entities-and-subscripts
cases.purpose: Org entities, subscripts and superscripts render as Unicode characters inside ordinary text.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-link-stays-in-the-paragraph
cases.purpose: A link renders inside its paragraph, so the text around it stays on one line instead of a block break.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-timestamp-renders-as-a-date
cases.purpose: An active timestamp renders as a date with the Chinese weekday and the time.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-planning-line-shows-both-dates
cases.purpose: SCHEDULED and DEADLINE render together on the planning line below the headline.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-checkbox-states-are-distinct
cases.purpose: Empty, done and in-progress checkboxes render three different marks.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-description-list-keeps-the-term
cases.purpose: A description list item renders its term and its description on one row.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-table-renders-every-cell
cases.purpose: A table renders its header row and every body cell.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-code-block-keeps-its-source
cases.purpose: A source block shows its language label and its body text.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-callouts-are-initialized-by-kind
cases.purpose: Warning and quote blocks render written labels and their content, not their uppercase block names.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-footnotes-are-numbered-and-listed
cases.purpose: A footnote reference is numbered and the footnote text is listed at the end of the document.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-comments-are-folded-initially
cases.purpose: A COMMENT headline starts folded, hides its body, and reveals it when the section is opened.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-unknown-block-counts-as-degraded
cases.purpose: An unclosed block keeps its text visible and is counted in the document's degradation count.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-missing-image-becomes-a-card
cases.purpose: A link to a missing image renders a placeholder card instead of signaling during render.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-theme-cycles-and-rejects-unknown
cases.purpose: Cycling selects the next fixed palette, an unknown palette signals the preview error, and a mounted document repaints.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-width-adjust-stays-in-range
cases.purpose: The reading measure clamps to the configured minimum and maximum.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-toc-toggle-hides-the-contents-card
cases.purpose: Hiding the table of contents removes the contents card from the mounted document.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-narrow-window-keeps-the-measure
cases.purpose: A narrow viewport still mounts and renders the document's headlines without signaling.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-locate-moves-to-the-heading
cases.purpose: Locating an outline entry moves point to that headline's row, so navigation and imenu use the mounted tree's own positions.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-heading-navigation-round-trips
cases.purpose: Next and previous heading move between headlines and return to the same row, so outline navigation never gets stuck on one heading.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-unknown-drawer-content-is-reachable
cases.purpose: An unknown drawer keeps a named chip and show-hidden reveals its text, so no drawer content disappears silently.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-targets-render-as-anchors-and-links
cases.purpose: A radio target renders as a quiet anchor and its reference as link text instead of leaking << markers.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-export-snippets-show-only-their-payload
cases.purpose: An inline export snippet shows its payload in source style without the @@backend: markers, and is never interpreted.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-src-line-numbers-follow-the-n-switch
cases.purpose: A source block with the -n switch numbers its lines from the requested start in a gutter.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-typeset-disabled-keeps-the-formula-source
cases.purpose: Disabling drawing leaves a display formula as readable source instead of removing it.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-live-edit-follows-the-unsaved-buffer
cases.purpose: An unsaved edit in the source buffer repaints the preview, so a preview can sit beside editing.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-inline-source-shows-only-its-code
cases.purpose: An inline source snippet renders its code without the src_LANG{ marker.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-ordered-lists-keep-their-style-and-counter
cases.purpose: A parenthesized ordered list keeps its own markers, and a counter cookie overrides only its own item.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-source-blocks-use-syntax-colours
cases.purpose: A named source block paints its tokens with the language's own syntax colours through the shared highlighter.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-table-rows-do-not-add-a-blank-line
cases.purpose: A table paints its rows one after another without an empty bordered row between them.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-logbook-without-properties-still-summarises
cases.purpose: A logbook that opens a section body is summarised as a chip instead of falling through as an unknown drawer.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-multiple-todo-sequences
cases.purpose: Multiple #+TODO keyword lines accumulate across sequences without overwriting earlier keywords.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-options-num-subscripts-and-flavor
cases.purpose: #+OPTIONS honors heading numbering depth, brace-only subscripts (^:{}) and etaf:nil standard flavor.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-currency-dollars-never-become-math
cases.purpose: Currency expressions like $100 to $200 stay plain text while strict $x^2$ renders as inline math.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-multiparagraph-footnote-and-return
cases.purpose: Multi-paragraph footnote definitions preserve all paragraphs and render a clickable return button.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-verse-block-preserves-indent-and-inlines
cases.purpose: Verse blocks keep leading indentation and parse inline Org formatting.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-paired-results-and-table-results
cases.purpose: #+RESULTS: fixed-width and table outputs pair cleanly beneath their source blocks.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-real-overdue-and-clock-minutes
cases.purpose: Real overdue counts (excluding DONE sections) and total clock minutes are derived against :today.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-toc-directives-tables-and-listings
cases.purpose: #+TOC: tables and #+TOC: listings generate interactive table and code indices.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-setupfile-include-and-bibliography
cases.purpose: Workspace #+SETUPFILE:, #+INCLUDE:, #+BIBLIOGRAPHY:, org-cite and #+PRINT_BIBLIOGRAPHY: resolve cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-node-define-extend-undefine-and-describe
cases.purpose: Users can define, describe, inspect derived attributes of, and cleanly undefine custom nodes.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-style-rules-on-headline-and-table
cases.purpose: Style rules apply uniformly to core Org nodes (headline, table) and forbid writing derived attributes.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-set-view-delegates-to-default-view
cases.purpose: etaf-org-set-view wraps shipped views via etaf-org-default-view and restores cleanly when passed nil.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-node-validation-degrades-inline
cases.purpose: Malformed container attributes show inline non-blocking diagnostics while sibling blocks continue rendering.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-standard-flavor-disables-extensions
cases.purpose: Standard Org flavor disables extended inline marks, spoilers and custom link micro-widgets.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-l0-containers-and-marker-tabs
cases.purpose: L0 containers (card, marker tabs, steps, timeline, file-tree, chat) render their structured layouts.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-data-bound-stats-and-chart
cases.purpose: stats and chart widgets bind directly to named Org tables via :from.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-cognitive-widgets-and-inline-micro-widgets
cases.purpose: Cognitive widgets, inline micro-widgets and global spoiler toggling render and update accurately.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-code-enhancements-and-table-options
cases.purpose: #+attr_etaf: enables code block titles, folding, line markers and sortable/copyable Org tables.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-l1-include-coderef-symbol-project-tree
cases.purpose: L1 workspace widgets read bounded project files and reject paths escaping the workspace root.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-org-exclusive-query-kanban-clock-transclude
cases.purpose: Org-exclusive org-query, kanban, clock-summary, transclude and clocktable dynamic blocks render live Org data.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-l2-actions-respect-trust-gate-and-update-block
cases.purpose: L2 widgets respect etaf-org-allow-actions and etaf-org-update-block dynamically replaces a named block view.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-preview-split-goto-source-and-close
cases.purpose: etaf-org-preview opens a non-destructive right split, goto-source jumps to the Org line, and toggle/close cleans up.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-live-filter-and-toc-toggle
cases.purpose: Live section filtering narrows visible sections non-destructively and clears back to the full document.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-callbacks-on-link-and-on-media
cases.purpose: Consumer :on-link callback intercepts link activation through the public session constructor.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-edit-mode-clean-teardown
cases.purpose: etaf-org-edit-mode provides live CAPF completion from the node registry and leaves source text intact on disable.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-doctor-reports-capabilities
cases.purpose: etaf-org-doctor reports zero required external tools and structured optional tool capabilities.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-src-renderer-hook
cases.purpose: etaf-org-src-renderers allows consumers to plug a custom view renderer for any source language.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-timestamp-repeater-range-and-list-citations
cases.purpose: Timestamps with repeater/warning delays and date ranges, citations inside list items, and single-semicolon [!code] markers render accurately.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-complete-gallery-mounts-cleanly
cases.purpose: The categorized complete-gallery.org showcase mounts with zero degraded blocks and renders all widget families cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-auto-theme-derives-colored-headings
cases.purpose: Auto theme derives chromatic heading colors distinct from body ink even when link and button faces are unspecified.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-command-surface-and-mx-predicates
cases.purpose: Two-tier M-x surface keeps strictly etaf-org-open and etaf-org-preview globally visible, scopes preview commands to preview buffers, uses customizable single-key defaults with zero prefix keys in etaf-org-keys, and dispatches cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-open-single-window-and-split-toggle
cases.purpose: etaf-org-open opens full-width without splitting, v toggles side-by-side split, e/o jumps in place, and q restores origin buffer.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-side-window-toc-peek-and-widget-fixes
cases.purpose: Independent configurable TOC side window (left default and right option, distinct per-item click jumps and n/p navigation), floating K peek dialog toggle, clean property drawer collapse without ghost text, and collapsible file-tree directory toggle all work cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-four-tier-hover-discipline
cases.purpose: Strict 4-tier leaf-only hover discipline (missing-hand=0, contrast>=3.0, ink preserved, no stacked active or static hover) holds across dark, light and sepia themes.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-card-accents-box-surfaces-and-tokens
cases.purpose: etaf-org-theme-tokens emits strictly 6-digit hex colors, dark sunken is strictly darker than page, and card semantic accents plus box surfaces render cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-editorial-widget-contracts
cases.purpose: Editorial widgets satisfy columns/file-tree/stacked-%/diff-order/narrow-timeline/balanced-sexp code-ref/symbol docstring contracts.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-code-blank-line-has-no-svg-cursor-box
cases.purpose: Blank lines inside rendered source blocks carry no SVG image display property that would trigger a full-row GUI cursor box.

cases.name: etaf-org-tests-accordion-and-details-edge-cases-and-hover-borders
cases.purpose: Org `details' and `accordion' blocks clamp multiple `:open t' sections in single-open mode, close cleanly and preserve border overlines with distinct hover fill across dark, light and sepia themes.
